how_to_edit: Active items: one slot, used with Space (the special button). Isaac-style.
charge: "rooms" refills one pip per room you clear (rooms = how many pips); "timer" refills over seconds.
Picking one up gives it fully charged. Picking up another swaps: the old one is left on the pedestal.
classes: which adventurers can find it. Only warrior items exist so far.
icon: attack, defense, move, mode, special, spell, gold, potion (the relic icon set).
effect: the numbers for what it does; see scripts/slasher/slasher_active_effects.gd for each kind.
treasure_chance: how often a treasure room holds an active item instead of a relic. The first treasure room of a run always does while your slot is empty.

shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
shadow_step.description: Dash a short way in the direction you're moving, untouchable while you do.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Spin with your blade out, hitting everything around you three times as hard and throwing it back.

earthsplitter.name: Earthsplitter
earthsplitter.description: Slam your sword down: a crack tears along the ground ahead, hurting and stunning everything in its path.

war_horn.name: War Horn
war_horn.description: A battle cry: for 6 seconds you hit 50% harder and swing 40% faster, and nearby foes are knocked back.

iron_skin.name: Iron Skin
iron_skin.description: Harden like iron: soak up the next two hearts of damage within 10 seconds.

eldritch_bowstaff.name: Eldritch Bowstaff
eldritch_bowstaff.description: Sweep nearby foes with stacking curses. Cursed deaths dissolve into allied corrupted mini-beasts.

demon_blade.name: Demon Blade
demon_blade.description: Draw blood to frenzy, gaining damage and attack speed while taking double damage.

storm_trident.name: Storm Trident
storm_trident.description: Throw into a targeted storm zone, pinning foes that take double damage until the trident is retrieved.

valkyrian_sling.name: Valkyrian Sling
valkyrian_sling.description: Loose a returning shot that ricochets through the enemy line and can be parried back stronger.

dragonbone_dagger.name: Dragonbone Dagger
dragonbone_dagger.description: Carve a rapid crossing wound whose stacking armor reduction makes every cut bite deeper.

archon_crossbow.name: Archon Crossbow
archon_crossbow.description: Fire a metal skewer that pierces and drags foes, gaining damage for every creature speared.

divine_hammer.name: Divine Hammer
divine_hammer.description: Call down a radiant smash. Killing a foe refreshes it and repeats on the nearest enemy.

grim_reaver.name: Grim Reaver
grim_reaver.description: Reap a huge critical arc; kills begin a rampage with increasing critical chance.

sentinel_shield.name: Sentinel Shield
sentinel_shield.description: Bash the front line with a stunning impact that drives enemies far backward.

umbral_bow.name: Umbral Bow
umbral_bow.description: Fire a shadow arrow that leashes and slows foes while stealing their speed.
